testimonials.quote: During his internship at Girl Meets Tech, Aditya delivered four live mainnet blockchain dApps in roughly five weeks, moving seamlessly across Solidity smart contracts, front-end development, and AI features. What stands out most is his range, reliability, and thoughtful, user-focused approach to taking ideas from a brief to a polished product. He works independently, meets deadlines, and communicates clearly.

experiences.summary: Shipped four MVPs end to end on one-week cycles. Each went to BOT Chain mainnet with a launch campaign on X, backed by 80+ Solidity tests across the four.
highlights: BOT Launchpad: no-code deployment of five contract templates from the user's wallet, plus a registry contract that only accepts contracts matching an official template's code hash.
InstantBlog: Gemini drafts cited articles from sources the user supplies; a SHA-256 fingerprint stamped on-chain shows who published a text and when.
GitAura: GitHub OAuth with server-signed proofs that the contract verifies on-chain.
ABI Studio: generates an interface for any contract from its ABI and publishes the layout to IPFS.
